coordinate_convention: 1-based inclusive canonical UniProt; split continuous topology intervals at annotated mature-chain boundaries
limitations: PDBe SIFTS accession-mapped span is not verified coordinate coverage or sequence identity. Unobserved residues and internal gaps require model-level inspection.
AFDB exact sequence/range metadata does not establish structural accuracy; coordinates, pLDDT, PAE and oligomeric arrangement not yet inspected.
No annotated subunit comment does not establish monomer state.
Sequence distance is not physical membrane proximity.
N-linked sequons are sequence motifs, not glycan occupancy. Disulfide annotations require chain and mature-state context.
Extracellular topology can represent organelle lumen; no luminal BBB accessibility inferred.
No model fragments approved, no ranking, no membrane MD decision before target and binding-site selection.
API missing/error responses are not proof of model absence.
